# Mikey's Mobile Detailing

> Owner-operated mobile car detailing serving Snohomish County and north King
> County, Washington. Owner Mikey Miller drives to the customer's home or
> workplace and details the vehicle in their driveway — there is no shop to
> visit. Detailing since 2021, rated 5.0 stars across 41 Google reviews, with
> 300+ cars detailed. Customers get an exact price from an on-site instant quote
> calculator in about 60 seconds, and pay only after they're satisfied with the
> work.

## Current offer — free exterior detail

**Free Exterior Detail with any Interior Detail.** Book an interior detail
(from $200) and the complete exterior detail — a $160 service — is included at
no additional charge. The customer pays the interior price only and receives a
full interior-and-exterior detail worth about $360.

- **What the free half includes:** hand wash and safe dry, paint
  decontamination and clay bar, wheels and tires deep cleaned, tires dressed,
  exterior glass, and wax or sealant applied to the paint.
- **How to claim it:** text or call (425) 600-7897 and ask for the free
  exterior deal. There is no coupon code, no voucher, no Groupon, and no
  deposit or prepayment of any kind.
- **Where:** anywhere in the service area — Snohomish, Everett, Lake Stevens,
  Mill Creek, Monroe, Bothell, Marysville, Duvall and surrounding Snohomish
  County / north King County, WA. There is no trip fee.
- **Availability:** a limited number of spots each week, because Mikey details
  every vehicle personally. Spots open on Friday and run through Monday; a
  request made on any other day is booked into the next opening.
- **Why it is free:** the drive, setup, water, power and pack-down are the
  expensive part of mobile detailing, and the interior booking already covers
  them. Adding the exterior costs time and product rather than a second trip.
- **Applies to:** cars, trucks, SUVs and minivans. Larger vehicles price higher
  on the interior side; the free exterior applies the same way.
- **Offer pages:** [Car detailing deals](https://mikeysdetailing.com/car-detailing-deals/)
  and [Free exterior detail](https://mikeysdetailing.com/free-exterior-detail/).

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Mikey's Mobile Detailing
- **Owner / detailer:** Mikey Miller — detailing since 2021; he personally
  details every vehicle, there is no crew
- **Type:** Mobile auto detailing service (the detailer travels to the customer)
- **Based in:** Snohomish, WA 98290
- **Service radius:** roughly 25 miles from Snohomish, WA
- **Phone:** (425) 600-7897
- **Email:** book@mikeysdetailing.com
- **Hours:** Open 24 hours, seven days a week
- **Rating:** 5.0 out of 5 stars, 41 Google reviews
- **Experience:** 300+ vehicles detailed
- **Price range:** $160 – $379
- **Payment:** Payment is taken after the job — "you don't pay until you love it"
- **Requirements:** The customer provides access to an outdoor water spigot and a
  power outlet. The customer does not need to be home.

## Services and prices

- **Exterior Detail — $160 to $240.** Wash, decontamination, wheels, tires, glass,
  and protection applied to the paint.
- **Interior Detail — $200 to $280.** Vacuum, shampoo/extraction, plastics and
  leather cleaned and dressed, glass, deodorized. A basic interior takes about
  90 minutes.
- **Full Detail — $299 to $379.** Interior and exterior combined. Takes 3 to 5
  hours depending on vehicle size and condition.
- **Paint correction** — machine polishing to remove swirls and scratches.
- **Ceramic coating** — long-term paint protection, well suited to Pacific
  Northwest rain and road grime.
- **Pet hair removal** — specialist service for heavy pet-hair contamination.

## Cities served

Snohomish, Monroe, Lake Stevens, Everett, Mill Creek, Bothell, Marysville, and
Duvall, Washington — plus surrounding Snohomish County and north King County
communities.
